sectionOrganization.issue: In Projects, "Riyadh Housing Prices Analysis (2024)" is listed before "Student Attendance Dashboard (graduation project, 2025)", but the 2025 project is more recent.
sectionOrganization.suggestion: List Student Attendance Dashboard (2025) first, then Riyadh Housing Prices Analysis (2024).

readability.issue: The last point under Junior Data Analyst, "Worked on data cleaning tasks for the team", uses a weak verb and gives no detail or result.
readability.suggestion: Rewrite it with a strong action verb and a specific result, for example "Cleaned [number] of records in [tool] to prepare them for the weekly dashboards."

contentFormatting.issue: Dates are written in two different formats: Month and year in Experience and Education (for example "Sep 2025 - Present"), but only the year in Projects and Certifications (for example "(2024)", "(Microsoft, 2025)").
contentFormatting.suggestion: Pick one date format and use it everywhere, for example adding the month to your Projects and Certifications dates if you remember them.
